scripts.deploy-prod: npm run build && powershell -Command "Push-Location dist; if (Test-Path .git) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .git }; git init; git checkout -b production; git add -A; git commit -m 'Production release'; git remote add origin https://github.com/Glenn-IT/Casamaria.git; git push origin production --force; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .git; Pop-Location"
scripts.package: npm run build && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist/*, dist/.htaccess -DestinationPath deploy.zip -Force"
